intent: I am excited and hopeful to have found the Gravitas beacon we thought was only a legend until now. I am also happy to have made contact with CatEye81. The antigen may help protect our future for a short time and may help someone in need. I need Big Mike to copy the delivery information correctly, but I am trying not to let my excitement make me careless over an open channel.
emotion: excited and hopeful, technically focused, trying to remain cautious over an open channel
